# Lorna Vane

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v4 c23 P27](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0027)</sub>
- **Role:** Lorna worked as a local teacher and later leased her farm, took in summer boarders, and planned a move to Montreal to pursue professional nursing.  <sub>[v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mrs. Rufus Vane; Mrs. Carrow; Lorna Vane  <sub>[v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 c11 P42](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0042)</sub>

## Appearance

Lorna is a striking and remarkably beautiful woman with long golden hair that glistens like fire, bright blue eyes, and ivory-colored arms. She is known for her signature attire of cheap cream-colored dresses paired with a belt or spark of bright crimson, which she wears because she feels discontented without a touch of red.

_Sources: [v4 c23 P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024)_

## Personality

Perceived locally as aloof, haughty, and distant, Lorna maintains a protective emotional wall to guard herself against past griefs. Beneath her guarded exterior, she possesses a vibrant, intelligent, and deeply loyal spirit full of enthusiasm, ambition, and humor when in comfortable company. Governed by a strong sense of duty and self-sacrifice, she endured years of hardship without complaint.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P29](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0029), [v4 c14 P6](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0006)_

## Traits

- Aloof and haughty exterior  <sub>[v4 c11 P29](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0029)</sub>
- Deeply dutiful and self-sacrificing  <sub>[v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035)</sub>
- Ambitious and highly intelligent
- Fond of the color crimson  <sub>[v4 c23 P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024)</sub>

## Abilities

- Accomplished student and teacher, completing two years of study in one at Regent's Academy
- Skilled artisan and seamstress
- Dedicated and experienced caregiver  <sub>[v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035)</sub>

## Goals

- To earn her own living and pursue higher education at Wexcombe College
- To protect her mother from losing her family home  <sub>[v4 c11 P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027)</sub>
- To fulfill her perceived marital duty by caring for her incapacitated charge  <sub>[v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035)</sub>

## History

Lorna grew up on the old Ainslie farm. After her father passed away, she inherited money from her grandmother West, enabling her to study at Regent's Academy, where she completed a two-year teaching program in one year and took a job at the Glen schoolhouse. When Abner and Rufus Vane threatened to foreclose on her family's farm, Lorna sacrificed her ambitions and agreed to marry Rufus Vane to spare her mother heartbreak. Following her mother's death and Rufus's departure on a voyage aboard the Four Sisters, she was left to manage the farm alone. Years later, Captain Saul brought back an incapacitated man missing his memory, whom Lorna believed to be Rufus. For eleven years, Lorna devoted herself to his constant care while leasing her farm and accommodating summer boarders like Adrian Treleaven to make ends meet. She developed a close friendship with Nell and Miss Winifred. It was eventually discovered that the man she had nursed for over a decade was actually Rufus's cousin, Laurence Vane, freeing her from her long burden.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 c23 P17](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0017), [v4 c23 P28](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0028), [v4 c32 P0](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0000), [v4 c32 P3](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0003), [v4 c32 P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of Rose Ainslie and grand-daughter of Grandmother West  <sub>[v4 c11 P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026)</sub>
- Inherited a sum of money from her grandmother to attend Regent's Academy
- Forced into a marriage with Rufus Vane under threat of property foreclosure  <sub>[v4 c11 P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027)</sub>
